---
title: "Other Publications"
---
```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

from bibtexparser import parse_file

library = parse_file("my_pubs.bib")

public_engagement = [
    e for e in library.entries
    if "public engagement" in e["keywords"]
]

public_engagement.sort(
    key=lambda e: int(e["year"]) if "year" in e else 0,
    reverse=True
)

for entry in public_engagement:

    title = (
        entry["title"]
        .replace("{", "")
        .replace("}", "")
        .replace("\\textsc", "")
        .replace("\\_", "_")
    )

    authors = (
        entry["author"]
        .replace(" and ", ", ")
        .replace("{", "")
        .replace("}", "")
    )

    authors = (
        authors
        .replace("Burton, Victoria J.", "**Burton, Victoria J.**")
        .replace("Burton, Victoria", "**Burton, Victoria**")
    )

    if "journal" in entry:
        venue = entry["journal"]
    elif "booktitle" in entry:
        venue = entry["booktitle"]
    elif "publisher" in entry:
        venue = entry["publisher"]
    else:
        venue = ""

    year = entry["year"] if "year" in entry else ""
    doi = entry["doi"] if "doi" in entry else ""

    print(f"**{title}**  ")
    print(f"{authors}  ")

    if venue:
        print(f"*{venue}* ({year})  ")
    elif year:
        print(f"{year}  ")

    if doi:
        print(f"<https://doi.org/{doi}>")

    print()
```
